name: DumpInfo

expect.contains:
Firmware Version: 0x92 = v2.0
Scan PICC to see UID, SAK, type, and data blocks...
Card UID: DE AD BE EF
Card SAK: 08
PICC type: MIFARE 1KB

description: The MFRC522 library's DumpInfo, unmodified: the library soft-resets the reader, sets its timer and turns the antenna on; held to it at 200 ms, the card answers REQA, anticollision and SELECT (UID DE AD BE EF, SAK 08: MIFARE 1KB), and the library authenticates every sector with the default key A and reads its four blocks: trailers show key A as zeros, the transport access bits FF 07 80 69 and key B; block 0 the UID, its BCC 22h, the SAK and ATQA. The card is halted after the dump, so it is dumped once.
